Precision aluminium bracket \u2014 candi.requirement: CNC-machine the bracket from 6061-T6 aluminium to plus/minus 0.02 mm.
Precision aluminium bracket \u2014 candi.capability: CNC machining of aluminium extrusions and profiles to plus/minus 0.1 mm, lengths up to 1.5 m.

Polycarbonate optical light guide \u2014.defeats: Capability-ignored accepts; keyword-overlap has no shared material word and rejects.
